findings.description: Two existing tests within the changed map-preview suite assert implementation text instead of behaviour. __tests__/mapOpeningPreview.test.ts:138-143 checks a source path expression. __tests__/mapOpeningPreview.test.ts:293-305 checks callback source tokens. Dead code or a disconnected callback can pass these checks. Your test-quality rule explicitly requires refinement of encountered assertions within scope. Remove these two tests, or assert the emitted Next file trace and observable readiness after a fresh map mounts.

risk_rationale: The change follows the authorised withholding procedure, preserves other venue records and walking distances, and retains the 384-hour freshness budget.
testing_summary: No tests ran, as required for this review phase. Reviewed all 1,528 changed files between 1794887fd8a20ee0e190695753042f8c8ff4ab4c and 9142d09f5c744fc39f0567a61c235e9d78192eaa. Read-only semantic comparisons covered both UK pack generations, every changed slim shard, manifests, seeds, archives, verification receipts and walking pairs. The four authorised IDs leave the curated index. The 66 retained seed rows change only verification and expiry dates. All 39,157 retained walking pairs preserve their prior distances. The 45,693 UK base rows preserve their records, except Oriole loses its removed curated owner. Slim shards agree with the full index. The map evidence hash matches the shipped eager cell. No additional simplification or access-policy finding was substantiated.
